hints.title: Complementary Subarray Formulation
hints.text: Picking k cards from the ends is equivalent to leaving behind a contiguous subarray of length n - k with minimal sum.

hints.title: Fixed Size Subarray Tracking
hints.text: Slide a window of length n - k across cardPoints, tracking the sum of cards left behind.

hints.title: Subtract from Total Sum
hints.text: Find the minimum sum across all windows of length n - k. The answer is total_sum - min_window_sum.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maxScore(self, cardPoints: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        n = len(cardPoints)
        window_size = n - k
        cur_sum = sum(cardPoints[:window_size])
        min_sum = cur_sum
        for i in range(window_size, n):
            cur_sum += cardPoints[i] - cardPoints[i - window_size]
            min_sum = min(min_sum, cur_sum)
        return sum(cardPoints) - min_sum
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all combinations of taking cards from left and right takes O(2^k) time without optimal substructure.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed-size window tracks the contiguous omitted portion in O(N) time with constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate inverts the problem to finding the minimum sum subarray of size n - k.
complexity.notes: If k == n, answer is total sum.
